newsitem.title: INDIA: India VSNL local share offer after GDR.
newsitem.headline: India VSNL local share offer after GDR.

text.p: Indian telecommunications firm Videsh Sanchar Nigam Ltd (VSNL) will launch a domestic share offer three to four months after its issue of global depository receipts (GDRs), an investment banking source said on Saturday.
VSNL is due to begin roadshows for its GDR around March 10, with the pricing due by the end of March.
The state-run firm plans to offer around 600,000 shares to local investors.
"The idea is that there should at least be an opportunity for retail investors to pick up the stock," said an investment banker close to the deal.
He said foreign institutional investors would not be allowed to pick up stock in the local issue.
"There will probably be a limit to the number of shares a retail investor can buy and the shares will probably be offered at an attractive discount," the banker said.
Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, Jardine Fleming and Salomon Brothers are global coordinators to the GDR issue.
